templates.title: Steady thermal slab
templates.description: Stable GetDP 3.5.0, serial linear nodal finite elements, metres and constant cross-sectional area. Thermal field is kelvin, conductivity W/(m K), source W/m3, flux W/m2; electrical field V, conductivity S/m, source A/m3 and current density A/m2. Flux is outward at either boundary and positive along +x in element tables.
templates.requires: Stable GetDP 3.5.0 executable. All fields are editable JSON; no Gmsh dependency.
